A01-D05 | Profiling proposal

Document text extraction. layout and embedded images are not reproduced.

The Book of Mindsets Ref. Interface & interaction with Art The original idea The Book of Mindsets as a debate forum for MFF and 18th. A place where MFF, based on an AM persona, could provoke and initiate debates on all topics relevant to AI development, across all opinions and expertise. Originally thought of as "a library" and a place to become "smarter". Initially called “Debate” it became “MindPool”, which conceptually we now call a “Mindset eXchange”. Inputs to MX are pools of knowledge, facts, articles, opinions, attitudes, reflections etc. These can be read and shared – and can/should be discussed continuously. Further development The idea of a virtual book arose because one can interact with AM/Art and, for example, request an extract or an AM/AI-edited version of the content on a theme/topic of the material in MX. The way to get this delivered generated the idea of “a device”. This should explicitly be the ultimate experience of learning/knowledge. Currently the device is thought of as a tablet (iPad or similar), which is “activated” with alerts about new/updates – and where reading/viewing is combined with eye tracking (e.g. Hawkeye) with effects such as "3D" views of images one is looking at, and e.g. logging/tagging words/phrases the eye dwells on – so that AM/Art ultimately learns the reader/user as a “person/identity”). A signup/login of a registered new user automatically triggers search/tracking on the net – “what we know about you” – i.e. everything that can be found about a user's identity – e.g. job, education, memberships, etc. can be registered up front and presented to the user by Art, who begins building the user's MX identity – so Art can “personalize” itself towards the user – i.e. Art develops a matching personality (gender, voice, tone and apparent emotional understanding of this user). In this context, Art should be able to “read” the user's interests and personality. This raises the question whether eye tracking can reveal this? Can specific reading patterns, and perhaps dwelling on certain words/phrases/images, reveal this? Scope The function thus becomes a “personalization” of both parties, so Art for instance can manifest itself (on the screen and/or via text/sound) and offer suggestions for reading and/or dialogue – e.g. to match with other debaters. Art thereby becomes a realized “AM”, which in this first “chatbot 2.0” version can take the role of mentor, teacher, friend/companion (or other functionality?). The device becomes a new online learning tool [an MFF product], thus more than just a (randomly chosen) hardware. Implications And the phenomenon “learning” is completely disrupted (as a new Post Corona life/lifestyle). Will such a new definition of “life-long learning” make public/private education accept this “challenge” – and how can such quality be assured across? (Ref. e.g. comparison to existing online education). Is it possible to “typecast” personality and character traits via eye tracking? (Ref. reverse engineering psychometric tests – i.e. a person has taken a test and got a result like Big 5, generally accepted as a characterization of personality types – can this be inferred without taking a test?). Will education/school systems/budgets in public and corporate HR functions accept such a new “certification”? Trials The first step is to test if (time)logging/eye tracking is valid enough that words (the linguistics) can be converted to values (Big 5 personality traits and Graves mindsets) into a pattern? Can it e.g. be measured in time (and FYI, DR has used this for many years [[████]] and various psychologists have used it for, among other things, pedophile cases, young people's driving habits, etc.), so the probability is mostly a “yes”. Can this be translated into an algorithm (like reverse engineering psychometrics)? Proposal We use HH 1-10 to identify (value-relative) words – and then measure selected test subjects to see if there is a difference in reading – i.e. if these words [and images] get more attention than others. Identification and marking of value/words is done by an NLP/Graves-certified coach […], Setup of experiments (equipment, measurements, tabulations etc. – e.g. at ZibarLab – and possibly in collaboration with SDU). Conditions for implementation Discussions about layout/login on the “MindPool” tab on the current website need to be changed. Navigation with “planets” and a final decision on indexing, including how uploads as comments etc. are registered/collected? Definition and production of “a device” and software for interactive dialogue with Art Policy for how to read for free, how to register as user/debater/blogger, and acceptance of such a “new cookie” type? How do we notify participants about “news” and matching etc. (ref. email alerts, etc.)? And ...
